agy-staff-0.6.1-overview.png.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: single polished technical overview image for local preview of GitHub PR #15.
Primary request: Draw the four important changes in agy-staff 0.6.1 as a clear Excalidraw-inspired hand-drawn infographic. This is the 0.6.1 PR overview, not later 0.7.0 work.
Scene/backdrop: completely solid white background, no grid, no paper texture.
Style/medium: precise but charming hand-drawn charcoal outlines, subtly imperfect rounded rectangles and arrows, restrained pastel blue, teal, amber and lavender highlights. Flat 2D. Generous whitespace. No photographic objects, no 3D, no shadows. Legible clean handwritten-style English typography, consistent visual hierarchy.
Composition: large landscape canvas, about 3:2. Top title and subtitle, four equally weighted panels in a spacious 2x2 grid, bottom workflow ribbon. Text must be readable, no tiny dense text. Use small simple relevant icons (clock, folder, shield, document) within the panels, not ornamental illustration.

Exact title: "agy-staff 0.6.1"
Exact subtitle: "PR #15 — Clearer boundaries for delegated work"

Top-left panel:
Heading "#8  Recoverable timeouts"
Draw a clock beside a retained conversation document and a small dashed arrow labeled "Continue?".
Text:
"Explicit timeout + no response"
"Keep conversation and workspace context"
"Report attention when resumable"
Small note: "Builds on 0.6.0 recovery"

Top-right panel:
Heading "#9  Attach the workspace"
Draw a repository folder connected by an arrow to an AGY CLI terminal window. Label the arrow exactly "--add-dir <repoRoot>".
Text:
"One shared invocation path"
"Foreground • Background • Resume"

Bottom-left panel:
Heading "#10  Simple restricted permissions"
Draw a compact shield between a small green allow box and a soft amber deny box.
Text:
"Broad git / gh allows"
"Five native deny prefixes"
List all five, each on its own short line:
"git push"
"git reset --hard"
"git clean"
"gh pr merge"
"gh release delete"
Small note: "Optional setup • Native AGY matching"
Do not imply universal protection or that these denies affect unrestricted mode.

Bottom-right panel:
Heading "Deliver facts, let the orchestrator assess"
Draw "agy-cli" -> "companion" -> "orchestrator" as a simple short chain. Under the companion put a document icon labeled "Response + diagnostics". Under the orchestrator put a decision diamond labeled "Task complete?".
Text:
"done = invocation ended"
"Observe only when needed"
Do not imply that companion detects hidden timeouts or that native SUCCESS proves task completion.

Bottom ribbon, simple centered flowing arrows:
"Prompt → Dispatch → Wait → Assess"
Below in smaller but legible text:
"No routine progress polling • No automatic continuation"

Constraints: English text only, preserve exact spelling of agy-staff, agy-cli, companion and all command names. No code beyond these short labels. No logos, watermarks or invented metrics. Do not claim recovery was first introduced in 0.6.1. Avoid red error crosses, clutter, paragraph text, heavy decoration and small unreadable footnotes.

Scene/backdrop: solid white background, no grid or paper texture.
Style/medium: match the reference's Excalidraw-inspired charcoal outlines, gently irregular rounded panels and arrows, clean legible handwritten English typography, pale blue, teal, amber, and lavender accents, flat 2D, generous whitespace. Composition: top title and subtitle, four spacious panels in a 2x2 grid, a simple workflow ribbon at the bottom. Small relevant icons, readable text, no paragraphs or tiny footnotes. Maintain the reference's restrained technical release-note tone.

Exact title: "agy-staff 0.7.0"
Exact subtitle: "Task orchestration with AGY."

Top-left blue panel:
Heading "agy:lead"
Draw a rounded box labeled "Your agent" with a smaller "agy:lead" label inside it, beside a simple clipboard icon.
Text:
"Orchestrate an ongoing task"
"Own decisions, review, and delivery"
"Delegate coherent outcomes"

Top-right teal panel:
Heading "Staffer by default"
Small line "Within the lead workflow"
Draw a prominent rounded "staffer" box with simple document and tool icons, plus a smaller group of three optional labels beneath it: "researcher", "reviewer", "implementer".
Text:
"Research • Write • Plan • Build"
"Specialists when useful"
Do not imply the existing standalone persona behavior has been changed.

Bottom-left amber panel:
Heading "Continue with feedback"
Draw a document labeled "Result", a feedback bubble, and a curved arrow back to the same conversation.
Text:
"Pass updated decisions and constraints"
"Keep useful conversation context"
"Check partial work after interruption"
Do not imply lossless recovery or live prompt injection.

Bottom-right lavender panel:
Heading "Reject overlapping turns"
Draw two request arrows toward a single conversation document with a small lock; one arrow enters and the second stops before the document.
Text:
"Running conversation → reject"
"No queued prompt"
"Wait, or cancel then continue"
Small but legible scope line:
"Companion jobs in the same worktree"
Do not claim a global AGY lock or automatic cancellation. Avoid red error crosses.

Bottom ribbon:
"Brief → Delegate → Assess → Continue / Deliver"
Below the ribbon:
"Claude Code • Codex • Pi"

Constraints: all English text, spelled exactly; retain the agy-staff naming and lowercase skill names. The design should feel like the next release in the same series as the reference, not a new brand identity. No fabricated speed claims, test counts, badges, or extra slogans. Keep the exact version 0.7.0.
